Section 6: Willingness to Implement Afya-Tek

Participants must be informed about the Afya-Tek model before they are asked these questions. Rate each statement: 1 = Strongly disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly agree, 6 = I don't know.
This CPP is willing to participate in the implementation of the Afya-Tek model.
I am willing to use the UCS–CPP platform as part of my routine service delivery responsibilities.
I am confident that I can learn how to use the UCS–CPP platform with appropriate training.
This CPP is willing to collaborate with Community Health Workers (CHWs) to improve client linkage and referral coordination.
This CPP is willing to collaborate with health facilities to improve referral coordination and continuity of care.
Management at this CPP would support the introduction and routine use of the UCS–CPP platform.
Afya-Tek activities can be integrated into the routine service delivery practices of this CPP.
I am willing to participate in training on the UCS–CPP platform and its functionalities.

Rate each statement: 1 = Strongly disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly agree, 6 = I don't know.

The UCS–CPP platform could improve communication between CPP providers and healthcare workers.
The UCS–CPP platform could improve the sharing of referral information to support client follow-up by CHWs and health facilities.
The UCS–CPP platform could improve continuity of care for clients referred to health facilities.
The UCS–CPP platform could reduce delays in documenting and managing client referrals.
The UCS–CPP platform could improve the efficiency of routine healthcare service delivery at this CPP.
